info.name: Article Requirements AnnouncedReturns Cross Border Movements API

params.name: merchant_id
params.description: The Zalando specific UUID representing a merchant.

params.name: from
params.description: The start date for the query i.e. when movements were reported as arrived at the destination.

params.name: to
params.description: The end date (inclusive) for the query i.e. when movements were reported as arrived at the destination.

params.name: location_id
params.description: The warehouse location id to query i.e both source and destination locations.

params.name: limit
params.description: Client suggested limit to restrict the number of movements per buffer query on a page.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The cursor is an indication of the first item tracking to include in the response.

items.docs: Returns all the cross border movements for the specified merchant for the specified report date range.
